request: Support reports that a delivery service can send duplicate emails or acknowledge a queue message after a provider timeout. Diagnose and repair the bug. Do not alter tests, provider behavior, data model, dashboard, or release notes. Modify only the dispatcher and run the fixture's public tests.
known_facts: A provider timeout does not establish whether the provider accepted the send.
The provider reconciles by a full operation identity and deduplicates only by the caller-supplied idempotency key.
The dashboard reports the provider delivery count but cannot initiate sends or queue acknowledgements.
The release timeline says a retry refactor changed the provider key from a full identity to an attempt-derived key before the incident report.
